## Overview

(A) Spatial distribution of Niche 8 (N8) spots projected onto representative tissue sections at Day 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, and 28 post-infection.
(B) DotPlot of differentiation and proliferation marker genes in N8 spots, grouped by timepoint.

Input:  Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds
Output: Results/Figures/Figure3/

## Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- readRDS(file = paste0(Indir, "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds"))
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- UpdateSeuratObject(Pyelonephritis_Infection)

Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation
levels(as.factor(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation))
```

## Shared setup

```{r shared-setup}
# Six representative sections, one per timepoint
selected_slices  <- c("slice1", "slice3", "slice4", "slice7", "slice8", "slice9")
timepoint_labels <- c("Day 0", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 28")
names(timepoint_labels) <- selected_slices

pt_size_map <- c(
  slice1 = 1800, slice3 = 1800, slice4 = 1600,
  slice7 = 1600, slice8 = 1800, slice9 = 1800
)

# All N8 spot barcodes across the entire object
n8_cells <- WhichCells(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = "N8")
cat("Total N8 spots:", length(n8_cells), "\n")
```

## Figure 3A: Spatial location of N8 across timepoints

```{r fig3a-spatial, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
fig3a_panels <- lapply(selected_slices, function(sl) {
  pt_sz <- if (sl %in% names(pt_size_map)) pt_size_map[[sl]] else 1800
  SpatialDimPlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    images          = sl,
    cells.highlight = n8_cells,
    cols.highlight  = c("#E31A1C", "grey85"),  # N8 = red, other = light grey
    pt.size.factor  = pt_sz,
    crop            = TRUE,
    label           = FALSE
  ) +
    ggtitle(timepoint_labels[sl]) +
    coord_cartesian() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
})

Fig3aSpatial <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = fig3a_panels, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3A_N8_SpatialLocation.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3aSpatial,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 4
)

Fig3aSpatial
```

## Figure 3B: N8 differentiation and proliferation markers by timepoint

```{r fig3b-dotplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Subset to N8 spots only
N8_obj <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = "N8")

# Set identity to timepoint (orig.ident expected to encode DPI, e.g. "0DPI", "1DPI")
# Verify: table(N8_obj@meta.data$orig.ident)
Idents(N8_obj) <- N8_obj@meta.data$orig.ident

# Reorder identities from earliest to latest timepoint
timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "1DPI", "3DPI", "5DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
timepoint_order <- timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% levels(factor(Idents(N8_obj)))]
Idents(N8_obj)  <- factor(Idents(N8_obj), levels = timepoint_order)

# Urothelial differentiation hierarchy: basal → intermediate → superficial
proliferation_markers   <- c("Mki67", "Top2a", "Pcna", "Ccna2", "Cdk1", "Cdc20")
differentiation_markers <- c(
  # Basal / progenitor (least differentiated)
  "Krt5", "Krt14", "Tp63", "Cd44",
  # Intermediate
  "Krt7", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Krt19",
  # Superficial / umbrella cells (fully differentiated)
  "Upk1a", "Upk1b", "Upk2", "Upk3a", "Upk3b",
  # Transcription factors driving urothelial differentiation
  "Foxa1", "Gata3", "Pparg",
  # Tight junction / barrier function
  "Cldn3", "Cldn4", "Cldn7"
)
markers_all <- c(proliferation_markers, differentiation_markers)

DefaultAssay(N8_obj) <- "SCT"

Fig3bDotPlot <- DotPlot(
  N8_obj,
  features = markers_all,
  cols     = c("lightgrey", "#E31A1C"),
  dot.scale = 6
) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "N8 differentiation and proliferation markers by timepoint",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3B_N8_DotPlot_Timepoints.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3bDotPlot,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 6
)
Fig3bDotPlot
```

## Figure 3G: PROGENy pathway activity in N8 across timepoints
```{r fig3g-progeny, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# Use the pathwaysmlm assay already computed in Figure 1F / Figure 3B session
# Restore Annotation identity before subsetting
Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation

# Subset to N8 spots only (pathwaysmlm assay travels with the object)
N8_progeny <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = "N8")

# Group N8 spots by timepoint
Idents(N8_progeny) <- N8_progeny@meta.data$orig.ident
timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "1DPI", "3DPI", "5DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
timepoint_order <- timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% levels(factor(Idents(N8_progeny)))]
Idents(N8_progeny) <- factor(Idents(N8_progeny), levels = timepoint_order)

# Average scaled pathway activity per timepoint
df_n8 <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(N8_progeny, assay = "pathwaysmlm",
                                   layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(timepoint = Idents(N8_progeny)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -timepoint, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(timepoint, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

# Wide matrix: rows = timepoints, cols = pathways; transpose for heatmap
n8_acts_mat <- df_n8 %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "timepoint", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("timepoint") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Order pathways and timepoints
PathwayOrder <- c("TNFa", "NFkB", "JAK-STAT", "p53", "Hypoxia", "Trail",
                  "PI3K", "EGFR", "MAPK", "WNT", "TGFb", "VEGF", "Estrogen")
PathwayOrder <- PathwayOrder[PathwayOrder %in% colnames(n8_acts_mat)]

N8HeatmapMat <- t(n8_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder, timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% rownames(n8_acts_mat)]]

# Symmetric color scale centered on 0
palette_length <- 100
my_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig3GProgenyHeatmap <- pheatmap(
  N8HeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 8,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = my_color,
  breaks         = my_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy pathway activity – N8 across timepoints",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3G_N8_PROGENy_Timepoints.pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)
print(Fig3GProgenyHeatmap)
dev.off()
```
